title: Quick Crispy Slovakian Tofu Wrap
description: A plant‑based, umami‑rich wrap featuring smoky paprika, crispy tofu en‑croute, and fresh Slovakian cabbage slaw for a quick fix meal.
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess moisture and cut into 1cm cubes.
In a bowl whisk flour, cornstarch, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Toss tofu cubes in flour mixture until well coated.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium‑high heat and pan‑fry tofu until crisp, about 6‑7 minutes, flipping once.
While tofu cooks, shred red cabbage, grate carrot, and tear lettuce into bite‑size pieces.
Warm the whole wheat tortilla in a dry pan for 30 seconds on each side.
Drizzle sweet chili sauce onto the tortilla, then evenly distribute tofu, cabbage, carrot, lettuce, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
Fold the sides of the tortilla over the filling and roll tightly into a wrap.
Slice the wrap diagonally and serve immediately with extra sauce on the side.
